marginal_stratification: is_rare + onset for evaluation splitting only
paired_controls: same sex, prefecture, 10-year age band, onset; no replacement
auc_ci: 300 within-split bootstrap resamples; descriptive, model-training uncertainty not included
multiplicity: Holm across 24 AUC and paired-AIA tests
not_official: Holdout queries are from B, not the nonshared block; no official phi correction. Constant10 baseline ignores C, and its excess cannot be corrected by synthetic data.
reuse: 4 splits reuse the same B; not independent cohorts
